payload.title: A deployment in another AWS organisation needs nothing from ours
payload.description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-e9e96f.

Remove default domains, the family footer registry and the default privacy link from core; make the monitoring stack and its seed scripts take the account from configuration; let Cyclotron support run in the deployment's own account.
